title: Update to CloudMicrophysics 0.50

body:
Two changes that speed up the 1M microphysics step with `implicit_microphysics: true`, without changing results.

## Changes

### Skip the node rule where every process rate vanishes

The bulk parameter set holds no vapor exchange, so its rates vanish in air without cloud condensate that holds only rain, or only snow at or below freezing. CloudMicrophysics returns zero for such states at every quadrature node (`BMT.no_rates`). Cells without cloud condensate that satisfy `BMT.no_rates` up to their warmest node now skip the node rule, whose sum is zero.

### Defer the 1M tendencies that only the implicit solve reads

ClimaTimeSteppers calls `cache_imp!` before the Newton solve, at each Newton iterate and at the solved state, and `cache!` at the end of each stage. Each call evaluated the SGS moments and the implicit 1M tendency, and `cache!` also the updraft 1M tendency of `PrognosticEDMFX`. Only the Newton residual and Jacobian read the implicit tendency before the next call overwrites it, and the implicit-stage predictor overwrites the updraft tendency before the solve reads it.

- The hooks are now `set_implicit_precomputed_quantities_deferred!` and `set_precomputed_quantities_deferred!`, which mark these tendencies out of date.
- `implicit_tendency!` and `update_jacobian!` evaluate them at the same state when they read them (`ensure_1m_tendencies!`).
- `set_precomputed_quantities!` and `set_implicit_precomputed_quantities!` still evaluate everything.
- With `PrognosticEDMFX`, the implicit environment tendency (SGS quadrature) is evaluated 2 times per ARS222 step instead of 6, and the stage-end updraft tendency is not evaluated.

## Performance

Coupled AMIP, 185 km, 79 levels, `dt` = 240 s, prognostic EDMF, Float32, A100, measured before the update to CloudMicrophysics 0.50: the median coupled step fell from 0.1637 s to 0.1423 s (-13%). The deferral, switched on and off within one run, takes about 8% off the step. Not remeasured against current `main`.

## Behavior

- Results are unchanged. On CPU, the `prognostic_edmfx_dycoms_rf02_column` and `prognostic_edmfx_rico_column` jobs (6 h) end in the bitwise state of `main`, so `ref_counter.jl` is untouched.
- Deferral: bitwise identical to the undeferred hooks in TRMM columns with the default settings, without Picard rounds, and with `update_cache_every: step`.
- Cell-level skip: the node temperatures are bounded by `T + 8 √T′T′`, which holds for all but `1e-13` of the quadrature weight. In a sample of 1.3 million skipped cells, the node rule returned at most `4e-16` of the species per timestep.

## Tests

- "1M wrappers return zero where no process rate remains" in `test/parameterized_tendencies/microphysics/microphysics_wrappers.jl`: the grid-mean and SGS-quadrature wrappers return zero for such cells, with and without precipitation placement, and nonzero tendencies above freezing or with vapor exchange. The predicate itself is tested in CloudMicrophysics.
- `test/prognostic_equations/deferred_1m_tendency_tests.jl`: the cache that `implicit_tendency!`, `update_jacobian!` and the explicit tendency read after the deferred hooks equals the cache of the undeferred functions, with and without Picard rounds.
title: Skip and defer 1M microphysics evaluations
